# Ledger Expense Tracker and Budget Manager
> Personal expense tracking, budget limits management, and savings goals application. Built with offline-first local storage and optional cloud database sync.

## Project Details
- Product: Ledger
- Entity: Ledger Technologies
- Founder: Pradeep Basha
- Registered Address: Indiranagar, Bangalore, Karnataka 560038, India
- Copyright: (c) 2026 Ledger Technologies. All rights reserved.
- Jurisdiction: India (DPDP Act 2023 compliant), GDPR (EU), CCPA (USA)

## Core Capabilities
- Offline-First Bookkeeping: Zero latency transaction recording with local storage fallback.
- Dynamic Budgeting: Category spending limit alerts and remaining balance calculation.
- Target Savings Goals: Goal creation, deposits, and target date completion tracking.
- Multi-Account Wallets: Offline cash wallets, bank checking accounts, and credit card accounts.
- Data Privacy & Minimization: Zero third-party ad pixels or tracking beacons. Complete right to access (export) and erasure (account deletion).
- CSV Export: Instant spreadsheet download for personal tax and accounting records.

## Architecture
- Frontend: React 18, Vite 5/8, Lucide React, HTML5 LocalStorage, responsive CSS3.
- Backend: Node.js, Express, MongoDB (Mongoose), JWT authentication with bcrypt salting.
- Security: Helmet CSP headers, express-rate-limit protection, HTTPS enforcement, user-scoped tenant isolation.
